_comment: Gamepad bindings (public/js/drive/gamepad.js): per action a stick axis or a button of the Gamepad API's standard mapping. axisN is stick axis N (0, 1: left stick x, y; 2, 3: right stick x, y; y grows downward), -axisN the same reversed; buttonN is button N (0 A, 1 B, 2 X, 3 Y, 4 LB, 5 RB, 6 LT, 7 RT, 8 Back, 9 Start, 10, 11 stick presses, 12-15 d-pad up, down, left, right, 16 Home). Walk and turn take -1..1, the grippers 0 (open) .. 1 (closed), the height actions while held. deadzone: sticks within it of center count as let go. Changed in the Teleop panel (Input: Gamepad), kept in the browser.
